'''Swellen''' was a world located in the [[Swellen system/Legends|Swellen system]],<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" /> within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A [[Battle of Swellen|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near Swellen during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
